subject.title: fix(msteams): add configurable timeout to Graph REST requests

question: Should MS Teams Graph helper functions expose a private per-request `timeoutMs` override now, or should the plugin keep only the fixed 30-second default until a concrete production caller needs a custom deadline?
rationale: Current main already has bounded Graph requests; this PR adds a new helper capability rather than repairing an unbounded current-main helper path, so the intended helper API shape depends on maintainer direction.

options.title: Accept Override After Proof
options.body: Require real Graph-helper timeout proof, then accept the optional private helper parameter as the intended MS Teams Graph helper shape.

options.title: Wait For A Caller
options.body: Keep only the fixed 30-second default until a specific Teams operation needs a shorter or longer deadline.

options.title: Require Caller Integration
options.body: Ask for the override to be wired into a concrete Teams operation so the new helper surface is justified by a product path.

recommendation.title: Accept Override After Proof
recommendation.body: Require real Graph-helper timeout proof, then accept the optional private helper parameter as the intended MS Teams Graph helper shape.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history on the shared MS Teams Graph helper and the overlapping timeout/default behavior.
